note: Requests to change an existing team, written with their expectations before their first run. They ask one thing: what the word rules applied after the model's answer (adviceIntentFromGoal in packages/core/src/team-draft.ts) change, and whether the change is right. Each case names a team under `teams`, its user messages in order and, when the person has already chosen, `decisions`. `expect.reply` lists the reply kinds that are right; `question` the question ids that are right when the reply is a question; `has` the edit kinds an `edits` reply must hold and `hasNot` the kinds it must not; `gate` the result a require_review edit must name; `topic` the topic of a describe reply. `rater` says why, for the person who reads the answers. A case with `repeat` is sent twice.
